sentences.english: My car is getting old.
sentences.chinese: 我的车越来越旧了。

sentences.english: I found an old photo of my parents from their wedding day.
sentences.chinese: 我找到了一张我父母结婚那天的老照片。

sentences.english: My grandfather is eighty years old, but he still walks two miles every morning before breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 我爷爷八十岁了，但他每天早饭前仍然要走两英里。

sentences.english: I have five dollars in my pocket.
sentences.chinese: 我口袋里有五美元。

sentences.english: We need to leave in five minutes if we want to be on time.
sentences.chinese: 如果我们想准时到，五分钟后就得出发。

sentences.english: I waited in line for five hours to get concert tickets, and by the time I reached the front, they were almost sold out.
sentences.chinese: 我排了五个小时队买演唱会门票，等我排到最前面时，票都快卖光了。

sentences.english: Happy New Year!
sentences.chinese: 新年快乐！

sentences.english: I've been studying Spanish for about a year now.
sentences.chinese: 我学西班牙语到现在差不多一年了。

sentences.english: This past year has been full of changes: I moved to a new city, started a new job, and made some amazing new friends.
sentences.chinese: 过去这一年充满了变化：我搬到了新城市，开始了新工作，还交了一些很棒的新朋友。

sentences.english: I only need one ticket.
sentences.chinese: 我只需要一张票。

sentences.english: Can I just have one more cookie? Just one, I promise.
sentences.chinese: 我能再吃一块饼干吗？就一块，我保证。

sentences.english: I spent one whole summer learning how to surf, and by the end of it, I could finally stand up on the board without falling.
sentences.chinese: 我花了一整个夏天学冲浪，到最后终于能在板上站起来不摔倒了。
sentences.scene: 回顾一个夏天的学习成果

sentences.english: I have two cats at home.
sentences.chinese: 我家有两只猫。

sentences.english: We're going on vacation for two weeks in July.
sentences.chinese: 我们七月份要去度两周假。

sentences.english: I only got two hours of sleep last night because my neighbor's dog wouldn't stop barking, and now I can barely keep my eyes open.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚我只睡了两个小时，因为邻居家的狗一直叫个不停，现在我眼睛都快睁不开了。

sentences.english: We have three dogs and one cat.
sentences.chinese: 我们有三只狗和一只猫。

sentences.english: I'll meet you at the coffee shop in about three hours.
sentences.chinese: 大概三小时后我在咖啡店跟你碰面。

sentences.english: I tried to bake cookies yesterday, but I burned three batches before I finally got the timing right.
sentences.chinese: 昨天我试着烤饼干，但在我最终把握好时间之前，连续烤焦了三炉。

sentences.english: Our table has four chairs.
sentences.chinese: 我们的桌子配了四把椅子。
sentences.scene: 描述餐厅或厨房的布置

sentences.english: The movie starts in four minutes. Let's hurry!
sentences.chinese: 电影四分钟后开始。我们快点！

sentences.english: I went to the store to buy milk and came out with four bags of snacks I didn't need.
sentences.chinese: 我去商店买牛奶，结果出来时手里多了四袋我并不需要的零食。
sentences.scene: 去超市控制不住购物的经历

sentences.english: I'll be there in ten minutes.
sentences.chinese: 我十分钟后到。
sentences.scene: 打电话告诉朋友到达时间

sentences.english: My little cousin just turned ten years old last weekend.
sentences.chinese: 我小表弟上周末刚满十岁。

sentences.english: I set my alarm for seven, but I hit snooze ten times and ended up being late for work.
sentences.chinese: 我把闹钟设在七点，但我按了十次贪睡键，结果上班迟到了。
sentences.scene: 典型的早上起不来的经历

sentences.english: My dog is six years old.
sentences.chinese: 我的狗六岁了。

sentences.english: We're having six people for dinner, so we need a bigger table.
sentences.chinese: 我们有六个人吃晚饭，所以需要一张更大的桌子。

sentences.english: I was stuck in traffic for six hours on my way back from the beach, and by the time I got home, I was too exhausted to even eat.
sentences.chinese: 从海滩回来的路上我被堵了六个小时，到家时累得连饭都吃不下。
sentences.scene: 假日回程堵车的痛苦经历

sentences.english: I have seven dollars in my wallet.
sentences.chinese: 我钱包里有七美元。

sentences.english: The restaurant opens at seven in the morning for breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 那家餐厅早上七点开门供应早餐。

sentences.english: I packed seven books for a weekend trip, thinking I'd have so much time to read, but I didn't even finish one.
sentences.chinese: 我周末旅行带了七本书，以为会有很多时间看，结果连一本都没看完。
sentences.scene: 高估自己旅行时的阅读量

sentences.english: Our team scored eight goals!
sentences.chinese: 我们队进了八个球！

sentences.english: I usually go to bed around eight o'clock on weekdays.
sentences.chinese: 平时我通常八点左右上床睡觉。

sentences.english: I remember being eight years old and believing I could dig a hole all the way to China if I just kept going.
sentences.chinese: 我记得八岁的时候，相信只要一直挖就能挖到中国去。

sentences.english: She has nine unread messages on her phone.
sentences.chinese: 她手机上有九条未读消息。
sentences.scene: 注意到别人手机屏幕的提醒

sentences.english: I waited for the bus for almost nine minutes in the rain.
sentences.chinese: 我在雨中等公交车等了快九分钟。

sentences.english: My grandmother had nine siblings, so family gatherings were always huge and loud and full of amazing food.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶有九个兄弟姐妹，所以家庭聚会总是人又多又热闹，还有很多好吃的。
sentences.scene: 回忆祖辈大家庭的热闹场面

sentences.english: I'll meet you at three o'clock.
sentences.chinese: 我三点钟跟你见面。

sentences.english: The alarm goes off at six o'clock every morning.
sentences.chinese: 闹钟每天早上六点钟响。

sentences.english: My dad used to come home from work at five o'clock on the dot, and I'd run to the door to greet him every single day.
sentences.chinese: 我爸以前每天五点钟准时下班回家，我每天都会跑到门口去迎接他。

sentences.english: Cut the apple into small pieces.
sentences.chinese: 把苹果切成小块。

sentences.english: I need to cut my hair. It's getting way too long.
sentences.chinese: 我需要剪头发了。它长得太长了。

sentences.english: I tried to cut open a box with a dull knife and ended up cutting my finger instead, so I had to go find a bandage.
sentences.chinese: 我试着用一把钝刀划开箱子，结果割伤了自己的手指，只好去找创可贴。
sentences.scene: 拆快递时不小心弄伤手的尴尬

sentences.english: Let's eat outside today.
sentences.chinese: 我们今天到外面吃吧。

sentences.english: I usually eat lunch at my desk while checking emails.
sentences.chinese: 我通常一边看邮件一边在办公桌旁吃午饭。
sentences.scene: 描述工作日的午餐习惯

sentences.english: I was so hungry after the hike that I could have eaten a whole pizza by myself, but I shared it with my friends instead.
sentences.chinese: 徒步之后我太饿了，一个人就能吞下一整张披萨，但我还是跟朋友们分享了。
sentences.scene: 运动后极度饥饿但不忘分享

sentences.english: This chocolate cake is so good!
sentences.chinese: 这个巧克力蛋糕太好吃了！
sentences.scene: 在派对上吃到喜欢的蛋糕

sentences.english: I baked a birthday cake for my mom with cream cheese frosting.
sentences.chinese: 我给我妈妈烤了一个生日蛋糕，上面涂了奶油奶酪糖霜。
sentences.scene: 为家人亲手做生日蛋糕

sentences.english: The cake looked so beautiful on the table, but when I tried to cut it, the whole thing fell apart because I had forgotten to let it cool down.
sentences.chinese: 蛋糕在桌上看起来很漂亮，但当我试着切的时候，整个蛋糕散了架，因为我忘了先让它冷却。
sentences.scene: 烘焙翻车：蛋糕没凉透就切导致碎裂
